- **Profile resolution (#46) fixed on both** — Android (a real observer race in `KernelProfileHost`) and iOS (6 row sites that read the profile synchronously but never subscribed to the change publisher; verified rendering "Bob Testnet" + avatar). Closed with before/after screenshots on the issue. [...] **Android read-path is genuinely validated and screenshot-verified** — onboarding (both nsec-import and create-account), timeline with resolved names, profile, DMs, relays, account, wallet, outbox, diagnostics all work under real interaction, no crashes or blank screens. The two bugs you flagged are fixed: profile resolution (a real race in `KernelProfileHost` — a collector attaching after the single no-replay event fired) and the nav bar (8 tabs → 5 + a More screen). One honesty note the agent made explicit: it couldn't photograph a "before" for the profile race because a loopback relay resolves too fast to reliably trigger it — the fix is code-level verified, not before/after-photographed. I'd rather you know that than have it claimed as a clean visual proof. [...] - Re-scoped chirp#46 from "cosmetic" to a **core bug** — profile resolution failing means every row shows raw hex instead of names/avatars, which is exactly why it looks half-baked.
- Filed chirp#47 for the **broken nav bar** (8 cramped tabs, mid-word wrapping) — which I should have caught by just looking. [...] Two of the three rendered rows show B's raw shortHex pubkey instead of the resolved "Bob Test" display name (only one row resolved it) even after the crash fix and a few seconds' wait. Feels like a per-row profile-cache/dedup quirk rather than anything related to the reversion or empty-feed root causes — flagging in case it's worth a follow-up issue, but didn't chase it since it's cosmetic and outside this task's scope. [...] PR #45 (re-pin + the JNI fix) is under a CI watch; I'll merge it when green. Filed the one cosmetic tail (chirp#46: 2 of 3 rows show raw pubkey instead of display name — a per-row profile-cache quirk, feed is functional).
